# Crates

Generated by `entity-runtime-docs` from `cargo metadata --no-deps`: every package of the workspace, with the `description` its `Cargo.toml` gives. There are 17 packages, all at the workspace version. None is published to a registry; depend on them by Git tag, as [the library guide](../guides/embed-the-kernel.md) shows. **Rust** is the package's declared minimum.

## Libraries and the command

| Package | In Rust | Features | Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`entity-cli`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-cli) | `use entity_cli`, binary `entity` | `eventlog-providers` | 1.85 | The `entity` command: the reference shell around entity-core — validate, inspect, graph, create, execute |
| [`entity-core`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-core) | `use entity_core` | none | 1.85 | IO-free, deterministic kernel for schema-driven, lifecycle-governed entities declared as data |
| [`entity-eventlog`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-eventlog) | `use entity_eventlog` | `file`, `postgres`, `sqlite`, `sync-bridge`, `tree` | 1.91 | Complete recorded Entity Runtime storage over Eventlog providers. |
| [`entity-executor`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-executor) | `use entity_executor` | none | 1.85 | Pure asynchronous execution over complete recorded Entity Runtime storage ports. |
| [`entity-graph`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-graph) | `use entity_graph` | none | 1.85 | Drawings of what a definition says: its lifecycle, and the references between types. Deterministic, no layout engine, no IO. |
| [`entity-mcp`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-mcp) | `use entity_mcp` | none | 1.85 | A synchronous stdio MCP tool surface over validated entities and a store |
| [`entity-postgres`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-postgres) | `use entity_postgres` | `eventlog-facade` | 1.85 | A transactional entity store over PostgreSQL: the provider an organisation actually runs, with a gate that says when it did not run. |
| [`entity-query`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-query) | `use entity_query` | none | 1.85 | Optional provider-neutral document queries for Entity Runtime stores. |
| [`entity-remote`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-remote) | `use entity_remote` | none | 1.85 | An entity store over a wire: the protocol, transport-agnostic, with the network at the edge. |
| [`entity-shell`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-shell) | `use entity_shell` | none | 1.85 | Provider-backed application operations shared by entity command surfaces |
| [`entity-sqlite`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-sqlite) | `use entity_sqlite` | `eventlog-facade` | 1.85 | A transactional entity store over SQLite: the provider that can write state and events atomically. |
| [`entity-store`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-store) | `use entity_store` | none | 1.85 | Provider interfaces for keeping entity instances and their events, outside the kernel. |
| [`entity-surface`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-surface) | `use entity_surface` | none | 1.85 | Deterministic public schemas, contracts and documentation projected from entity definitions |
| [`entity-yaml`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-yaml) | `use entity_yaml` | none | 1.85 | YAML adapter for entity-core definitions: text in, validated definition out, no IO |

## Repository tooling

Generators and checks the repository's own gate runs (`publish = false`). Nothing outside the repository depends on them.

| Package | In Rust | Features | Rust | What it is |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`entity-runtime-docs`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-runtime-docs) | binary `entity-runtime-docs` | none | 1.85 | Generates the derived pages of the Entity Runtime documentation site (CLI reference, crate list, status) and checks them for drift. |
| [`entity-xtask`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/entity-xtask) | binary `entity-xtask` | none | 1.85 | Repository-only checks that do not belong in the public entity command: today, that the local aep is new enough for the planning store (task plan-check). |
| [`scan-support`](https://github.com/beyond10x/entity-runtime/tree/main/crates/scan-support) | `use scan_support` | none | 1.85 | Reading a Rust source file well enough to say what its code names, and a manifest well enough to say what it depends on. Test support only. |
